config.thewatcher.title: The Watcher Configuration
config.thewatcher.fear_increase_multipli: Multiplier for how fast fear increases.
config.thewatcher.fear_decrease_multipli: Multiplier for how fast fear decreases.
config.thewatcher.torch_fear_reduction.t: Slows down fear increase while holding torches. 0.4 = 40% slower.
config.thewatcher.fake_crash_enabled.too: Enables the jumpscare that simulates a game crash (between 40% and 80% fear).
Enables delayed auditory echoes of your actions (e.g., hearing a block break seconds later).
Allows item names in your inventory to temporarily change into whispers.
config.thewatcher.hotbar_drift_enabled.t: Enables random swapping of items in your hotbar when your fear is high.
config.thewatcher.environmental_events_e: Enables environmental events like doors closing or torches breaking.
config.thewatcher.animal_staring_enabled: Nearby animals will stare at you when your fear level is high.
config.thewatcher.shadow_enabled.tooltip: Enables or disables the spawn of The Watcher (the shadow).
Fear level required for The Watcher to attempt spawning.
config.thewatcher.fear_bar_anchor.toolti: Side of the screen where the fear bar is anchored (LEFT or RIGHT).
config.thewatcher.fear_bar_y_offset.tool: Vertical offset of the fear bar (in pixels). Negative values move it up, positive values move it down.
